content:
harper: rooftop cornhole + semi-final watch party Friday 6pm? losers bring snacks, winner gets the fancy office foam finger. :corn: :hand_splayed: 
noah: i'm in. will miss half the game but can manage tosses and tactical yelling. :grin: 
jules: love a foam finger. can we do a tiny side pool for predict-the-score? $1 to enter, winner gets a bag of chips?
samir: depends. are you allowing trick tosses (behind-the-back, left-hand only)? :eyes:
harper: rules quick: single-elim cornhole bracket, best of 3 rounds, trick toss allowed but no wobbly parking cones as targets. $1 pool for score predictor, tiebreaker = combined overtime minutes.
noah: spreadsheet? we'll need brackets and to track Venmo payments.
harper: sheet: https://tiny.redwood/rooftop-cornhole (post emoji to confirm). also tagging ops to reserve rooftop lights.
ops-bot: Request received: "Rooftop lights and table" Friday 6pm. Facilities will confirm.
jules: sign me up :raised_hands: (pool + cornhole)
samir: sign me up :point_up: (cornhole only) and i'll bring a portable speaker. playlist suggestions accepted.
noah: small side bet: if someone hits 3 in a row they get +2 points in the predictor pool. is that ridiculous? yes, i'm proposing it.harper: agreed. 3-in-a-row bonus ON. also selfie requirement for foam finger handoff. documentation matters. :camera_with_flash: 
jules: can we have a consolation prize for 3rd place? like a vintage snack bag or leftover conference swag.
harper: consolation = retro sticker pack. winner = foam finger + bragging rights + first dibs on snacks. losers chip in $3 max for snacks.
noah: calendar-bot, add an invite and ping the APAC folks (we'll stream highlights).
calendar-bot: Event created: "Rooftop Cornhole + Semi-Final Watch" Fri 6:00pm  8:30pm. Invite sent to #random.
samir: logistics Q: weather fallback?
harper: fallback = lobby atrium cornhole course with taped lines. indoor-friendly.
jules: i'll Venmo $1 to @harper for the predictor pool (note: "cornhole pool").
noah: i'll bring a bag of chips and some extra bean bags. pro tip: duct tape them before you leave.
harper: final note: please put your slack handle in venmo note so i can mark paid. locking signups 5pm Friday. see you there, may the flukiest toss win. :crossed_fingers:
